name: interim_hc_active
hypothesis: Teams currently playing under an in-season interim head coach (a mid-season firing) show a motivation/effort discontinuity that lifts their ATS cover rate relative to the rest of the league.

reliability_check.reason: under_interim is a one-off situational event tied to a specific mid-season coaching change, not a persistent per-team trait that recurs year over year -- there is nothing to split-half.
